g.text: Embedding, reranker and Candle started by their own recipes
One engine set started (the others stopped)
Set judged against the owner rule
cmd: just engine-pairs | pass: retrieval-up and candle-up exit 0, and memory in use is at most 50% before the run
cmd: just engine-pairs | pass: every engine in the set answers GET /v1/models 200
cmd: just engine-pairs | pass: a table row with requests, failed, peak GiB, peak % and PASS or FAIL read from /proc/meminfo and HTTP status codes
cmd: just engine-pairs | pass: prints 'PASS engine-pairs' (every set met the rule) or 'FAIL engine-pairs' (the table is the evidence); retrieval-down and candle-down ran
